scope: STRIDE, three sittings, one voter, 255 cross-lane pairs at one place over 200 claims; 7 findings had no vote in their sitting. 28 of the 30 duplicate votes have a cross-lane partner at one place. By claim: the shared-control rule fires on 111, of which 19 are voted duplicate and 92 not; it does not fire on 89, of which 9 are voted duplicate. By pair: shared control 37 one finding and 77 two; no shared control 33 and 108. distinct_mechanisms False: 57 and 113; True: 13 and 72. A fold on a shared control would remove 92 claims voted as their own finding to catch 19. A pair is labelled one finding when either side is voted duplicate, which over-counts where a claim has several partners, so the precision figures are an upper bound.
